jobs.description:
As a Team Leader, you are the right-hand person of the Supervisor and lead a team of approximately 12 warehouse operators. You ensure that all rules and procedures related to cleanliness, safety, and quality are followed, and that the warehouse is always maintained to the highest standards.

You work closely alongside your team on the warehouse equipment and are primarily responsible for operational leadership and guidance. You collaborate closely with the Supervisor, who is your direct manager.

What does our ideal Team Leader look like?

As a Team Leader, you are fluent in Dutch and have strong communication skills in English. Knowledge of French is considered an asset. Ideally, you have experience working in a logistics warehouse environment and have already held a supervisory or leadership role.

You are a team player who is accurate, independent, positive-minded, and driven to achieve results. You possess the necessary leadership skills to motivate and guide your team effectively, and you hold a valid forklift or reach truck certificate.

Production Operator with Technical Insight Wanted in Kampenhout!

Do you have experience in a production environment and enjoy taking responsibility?

This company, located in Kampenhout, is a leading producer and supplier of professional fluids for the automotive and industrial sectors.

From this site, they manufacture a wide range of maintenance, cleaning, and consumable products for workshops and garages.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Production Operator with technical insight who enjoys working independently and taking responsibility for an entire production line.

Your Challenge

As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for correctly setting up, converting, starting, and operating the production line.

You will ensure that every product is manufactured and filled according to the required specifications.

Your Responsibilities

Production Line Changeovers

• Adjusting and converting the production line according to technical specifications.
• Changing packaging materials, caps, labels, and boxes.
• Setting up printing information on bottles, cans, and boxes.
• Selecting the correct production programs and parameters.
• Starting up the production line.

Filling and Production

• Interpreting and following technical specifications and work instructions.
• Checking materials at the production line.
• Replenishing labels, packaging materials, and other production supplies.
• Manually packing finished products into boxes.
• Performing quality checks on weight, dosage, and product finish.
• Adjusting and fine-tuning machine settings when necessary.
• Monitoring the supply and flow of liquids throughout the process.
• Connecting new tanks to the production system.

Technical Follow-Up

• Detecting malfunctions and assisting in resolving them together with the technician.
• Reporting accurately to the Production Manager.
• Ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency throughout the production process.

REF:MEC1

• You have experience working on a production line.
• You work in a highly responsible and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on quality and safety.
• You are organized and tidy; you remove production waste and clean your workstation before handing it over to colleagues on the next shift.
• You are hands-on and capable of lifting and handling heavy objects with ease.
• You are eager to learn and support your colleagues; a technical background or education in mechanics or electrical/electronics engineering is a strong advantage, whether completed or not.
• You are dynamic and able to perform well under pressure.
• You are flexible and willing to work in different shifts (6:00 AM – 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM) and/or in the day shift (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM), depending on production needs. The same flexibility applies to overtime.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

Air Cargo Belgium (ACB) is the official representative of the air cargo community at Brussels Airport Cargo. With over 
170 member companies, we bring together airlines, handlers, forwarders, the airport authority and other stakeholders. We connect, inspire, and 
strengthen the Brussels air cargo community through events, projects and communication.
 

Every year we organize several events that range from content-driven seminars with 20 participants, to bigger networking events like our BBQ with over 700 guests, to more leisurely events like a football tournament. Additionally, we also organize smaller activities like handing out Easter Eggs.
 

With our renewed strategy, we aim to grow from 
3,000 yearly event visitors/participants to over 7,000 in the coming years. This means more events, new ideas on how to best reach our audiences and more strong communication! To make this happen, we’re looking for a 
Community Engagement Coordinator to join our team.
 

Your Role:As our new Community Engagement Coordinator, you will:
 

Events & Coordination
 
 

• Take the lead in event coordination from A to Z, including the planning, promotion and execution of workshops, seminars, networking events and larger community events. 

• Work closely with our Community Engagement Lead, another coordinator and the wider ACB team to ensure smooth event organization and execution. 

• Occasionally represent ACB, and support the community, at international fairs and events.  

Communication & Content
 
 

• Manage and grow ACB’s social media presence in collaboration with your community engagement colleagues, using tools such as Canva and scheduling tools to create engaging and professional content. 

• Create engaging content for newsletters, social media and online updates, highlighting community news, success stories and relevant information 

• Support the promotion and visibility of ACB’s initiatives, events and community activities.  

Community Engagement & Partnerships
 
 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with our member companies and act as a central point of contact for the community. 

• Contribute to and execute ACB’s community engagement strategy, tailored to the dynamics of the air cargo industry. 

• Gather feedback from community members and translate it into actionable recommendations to continuously improve our community engagement 

• Support the growth of memberships and sponsorships by attracting and engaging relevant stakeholders. 

• Identify and develop partnerships with relevant stakeholders to strengthen the visibility and impact of the ACB community. 

• Monitor engagement metrics and data and report on the results and impact of community engagement initiatives. 

• Act as a visible presence within the community by visiting members to share information, gather feedback, distribute materials and support campaigns or initiatives. 

Your Profile:
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Event Management or Marketing (or similar). 

• 3–5 years of relevant professional experience (preferred). 

• Excellent writing and communication skills in English (all external communication). 

• Good knowledge of Dutch (our internal team language). 

• Good knowledge of French, as the role involves direct contact with warehouse staff. 

• Hands-on experience with graphic design (e.g. designing posters with Canva or similar) and a good eye for visual communication. 

• Social media fluency and confidence in creating and managing engaging content across platforms. 

• A people-oriented personality: you enjoy meeting people, building relationships and making new contacts. 

• A proactive attitude: you take initiative, see what needs to be done and act on it. 

• A valid category B driving licence (required for driving a van/minibus for our events). 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Open to learning about aviation and air cargo and connecting with major players in the industry.  

A standard desk job isn’t enough for you — you love variety, dynamism and contact with people.

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

 
• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.
 
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.
 
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.
 
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.
 
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality. 

 
• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.
 
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.
 
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.
 
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.
 
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.
 
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.
 
• Good physical condition for physical work.
 
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.
 
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.
 
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.
 
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.
 
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).
 
• “You are open to working weekends.

Main Responsibilities

The Technical Sales Manager contributes annually to the development of a strategic sales plan, in consultation with management (including objectives, KPIs, segmentation, and action points). In addition, weekly consultations and monthly reporting will be required.

Building and expanding a proactive and sustainable network of customers, prospects, partners (suppliers, machine builders, ...)

In most projects, the Technical Sales Manager will act as coordinator between customers, engineering offices, partners, suppliers, and the Revimaxx team.

You continuously monitor the market and trends and also share these internally. You pay attention to developments in technologies, relationships between customers/partners, subcontracting, opportunities, ...

You are open to and contribute to active marketing support, social media communication, participation in trade fairs, training sessions, ...

In this role, a combination of technical/mechanical expertise and a sense for economic reality is necessary. This may have been built through experience, interest, education... or perhaps through a combination of these.

• Industrial Engineer, Civil Engineer, or equivalent through experience
• Initial technical sales and/or consultancy experience (with technical expertise) and demonstrable results are a must, with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
• You have a strong affinity with the machine construction sector and are passionate about the mechanical possibilities of small and large machines/systems.
• Your commercial experience motivates you to independently evaluate opportunities and pursue them.
• You are conceptually strong and enjoy thinking together with the customer in a co-creative way to arrive at the best solution for their challenge.
• You are analytical and skilled with numbers in order to quickly determine margins and feasibility of projects. You have a sense for the economic reality of each project.
• You possess strong communication skills and communicate effectively with customers, partners, and the Revimaxx team. (knowledge of perfect English, and willingness to learn Dutch quickly)
• You have a natural ambition to grow and to support the growth of Revimaxx.
• You are results-oriented, loyal, flexible, and demonstrate strong perseverance.
• You hold a valid for wheel driving licence.

•

jobs.occupation: AI Security Engineer – LLM & GenAI Security
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Perform threat modeling, risk assessments, and security evaluations for GenAI, ML, and agentic AI solutions.
• Develop security guardrails for identity management, least privilege, data protection, and prompt security.
• Test for abuse scenarios such as prompt injection, data exfiltration, and unauthorized tool usage.
• Integrate security requirements into sandboxes, gateways, CI/CD pipelines, and production platforms.
• Design security monitoring and incident response protocols specifically for AI components.
• Evaluate the supply chain risk of vendors, models, libraries, and external AI services.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in security engineering covering cybersecurity, cloud security, IAM, or DevSecOps.
• You possess 3+ years of experience integrating security controls within software development pipelines and cloud platforms.
• You bring 1+ years of experience identifying security risks associated with LLMs, agents, and model supply chains.
• You have 1+ years of experience conducting technical security testing and risk assessments.
• You possess 1+ years of knowledge regarding GDPR, AI Act, or NIS2 frameworks.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with strong analytical and communication skills.
• You have active knowledge of Dutch OR French (with good understanding of the other language), and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience within the public sector or the G-Cloud environment.
• Ability to translate technical findings into actionable measures for non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities

• Create and maintain the product backlog while prioritizing features and technical synergies for upcoming sprints.
• Translate complex end-user needs into clear technical requirements for the delivery team to ensure successful solution delivery.
• Develop and execute a strategic delivery roadmap while managing associated risks, issues, and budgets.
• Ensure high-quality solution delivery by overseeing functional testing and alignment with customer design requirements.
• Facilitate stakeholder communication and manage technical or organizational conflicts to ensure operational functionality.
• Coach and motivate delivery squads to ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices.

Requirements

• 5+ years experience as a Product Owner or Scrum Master within an Agile environment using Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe.
• 5+ years expertise in Systems Integration and Enterprise Integration Patterns.
• 5+ years of experience with development support tools such as JIRA.
• 3+ years experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), specifically with Authentication, SSO, PKI, or PAM.
• 3+ years working with REST APIs.
• 3+ years knowledge of Information Security Standards (ISO 2700x) and IT Security Risk Analysis.
• Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent through experience.
• You're structured, organized, and possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• You are fluent in English with very strong knowledge of French and/or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Strong coaching and training skills.
• Knowledge of Cyber Security principles including ciphers and cryptography.

Responsibilities

• Manage, maintain, and automate Azure infrastructures following Infrastructure as Code principles.
• Support container platforms based on Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
• Implement and monitor logging, alerting, and performance solutions for cloud environments.
• Maintain cloud network components, security configurations, and access management.
• Provide technical coaching and knowledge transfer to ensure long-term expertise within the team.
• Analyze existing infrastructure to resolve configuration drift and optimize operational continuity.
• Collaborate with stakeholders in an Agile environment to align security and compliance requirements.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience with cloud platforms focusing on Microsoft Azure, AKS, Azure Functions, and Logic Apps.
• 8+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, including state management and modularization.
• 5+ years of experience with containerization technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
• 5+ years of experience with CI/CD automation and version control using GitHub Actions and Git.
• 5+ years of experience with scripting for automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
• 3+ years of experience with cloud networking components including Azure Firewall, vWAN, VNets, and DNS.
• 3+ years of experience with monitoring and security tools such as Azure Monitor, Grafana, Key Vault, and RBAC.
• Possess a proactive, result-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Demonstrate a collaborative approach within multidisciplined Agile teams.
• You are native in Dutch or French with professional working knowledge of the other and good professional English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications such as AZ-400, AZ-104, CKA, or CKAD.
• Experience with GitOps principles and tooling like Flux.
• Experience working in regulated environments or the public sector.
• Familiarity with Jira for project management.
• Willingness to coach and train technical colleagues.
